newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOUTH AFRICAN BOND EXCHANGE HEAD RESIGNS.
newsitem.headline: SOUTH AFRICAN BOND EXCHANGE HEAD RESIGNS.

text.p: The Bond Exchange of South Africa's chief executive officer, Graham Lund, on Thursday announced his resignation with effect from February 1997.
Having completed his original mandate to establish a licenced bond exchange, Lund had accepted a position as executive director of Mercantile Bank Ltd, the exchange said.
The exchange said a successor to Lund would be chosen by the executive committee, which will meet early in 1997.

The process of formalising South Africa's over-the-counter bond market started in 1989 with the establishment of the Bond Market Association. Under Lund's leadership the body was licenced as a financial exchange in May this year.
